sentences.en: I was disappointed at there being so little to do.
sentences.zh: 我对没什么可做的事情感到失望。

sentences.en: The candidate was disappointed at the outcome of the election.
sentences.zh: 候选人对选举结果感到失望。

sentences.en: I could not but feel disappointed at hearing the news.
sentences.zh: 听到这个消息我不能不感到失望。

senses.zh: 失望的,沮丧的，失意的v.使（人）失望( disappoint的过去式和过去分词),使破灭，使落空
